attack.note: Cursed Strikes makes every basic attack cleave and cut enemy attack speed 40 percent for 4 seconds (5 attacks). Harvest Vitality, Rapid Harvest and Grim Scythe all build on autos. Spectral Scythe returns to him after a delay and is a skillshot, not a ranged dealer role.

poke.note: Spectral Scythe (190, 1 second delay) and Echoes of Death hit a line and can be dodged. Bone Spear is a line poke with a 12 second cooldown. Poison Nova is a 10 second dot that melee heroes cannot dodge but ranged heroes can.

damage.note: Skeletal Warriors, Cursed Strikes cleave and Poison Nova (630 over 10 seconds) are spread chip damage. A strong AoE healer undoes Poison Nova, while Mortal Wound cuts healing by 75 percent after a scythe hit. Measured siege damage 8011 per minute is far above the median 4430, and hero damage 2002 is near the median.

cc.note: Bone Prison has a 2 second delay and roots for 1.75 seconds (2 with Amplify Damage). Skeletal Mages and Decrepify slow 30 percent. Cursed Strikes is attack speed reduction, not movement. Measured CC on enemies 29.6 seconds per game.

good_into.why: Cursed Strikes cleaves and slows attack speed 40 percent, Poison Nova hits melee heroes that cannot dodge it, and Weaken cuts their damage 35 percent. The guide says he excels against melee compositions.
Poison Nova over 10 seconds is hard for Lt. Morales or Uther to undo across a team, and the guide names this. Mortal Wound adds 75 percent healing reduction.
Wave clear plus Raise Skeleton make minion waves pile onto towers while he rotates, so he wins lanes and siege when the enemy does not answer.
Cleave and AoE abilities clear summons and pets cheaply and his own skeletons win exchanges against them.

bad_into.why: He has no mobility and Bone Armor is his only defense. Crowd control that holds him lets burst kill him, the guide lists very susceptible to CC.
Ranged heroes dodge Poison Nova and keep out of Cursed Strikes. Skeletal Mages is a slow tool, not a gap closer.
Slow hit speed and no gap closer, so chasing kiters is not possible without Decrepify and Skeletal Mages.
Mobile burst heroes (Jaina, Sgt. Hammer, Zeratul) follow up crowd control before Bone Armor lasts. Low early game and no escape.
Poke gets full value because he has no way to engage and Cursed Strikes does nothing against distance.

wants_from_team: A tank to engage so he can follow up
Burst follow up for Bone Prison (Li-Ming, Tyrande, Falstad)
Protection from crowd control (Medivh Force of Will)
A team that can fight 4 against 5 while he split pushes
gives_team: Top tier wave clear and siege with skeleton pressure
Root setup for a priority target
Slows and zone from Skeletal Mages
weaknesses: Needs levels for Harvest Vitality or Decrepify
